thread:
Maria: FYI customer AcmeProd wants Frostwing-13b onboarded to Dedicated with 4-bit quant. They reported hallucinations in prior model and want evals + safety checks.
Ashwin: Can we fit into this week's quant bucket? What's size/seq? :thinking: 
Maria: Model is 13B dense, typical seq 2048, target latency <120ms p50. They want GPTQ 4-bit and perf target cost-per-token <= $0.0008.
Jordyn: Priority: high -> customer has a POC. Need quant smoke, eval suite (truthfulness, instruction-following), and perf bench. I'll take evals.
Ashwin: I'll spin a quant job on 4x A100, run GPTQ + int8 fallback. Expect 6-8h.
Sam: Heads up, routing wise need model variant label frostwing-13b:4q for routing and fallback to frostwing-13b:int8.
Maria: Quick onboarding checklist: 1) ingest model artifacts + checksums, 2) convert to HF-compatible format, 3) quantize (GPTQ 4-bit), 4) smoke generate tests, 5) eval harness (truthfulness/regression), 6) perf bench, 7) add to catalog with perf profiles, 8) canary rollout config.
Jordyn: Eval details: truthfulness (3 datasets), long-answer hallucination sim, instruction-following (12 prompt families), edge-case safety (policy filter). Need baseline numbers from cascade-13b dense.
Ashwin: Note on KV cache: 4-bit GPTQ changes alignment. runtime needs to support 4-bit chunking for KV layout. @lee_eng-runtime pls confirm memory allocator compat.
lee_eng-runtime: runtime check: we support custom chunking but need to patch allocator for 4-bit strides. I can ship a small PR today and coordinate a staging deploy.
EvalBot: Automated eval job queued: frostwing-13b:4q vs cascade-13b:dense. job_id=8992. ETA ~10h.
Sam: If eval regressions > 2% on fidelity or >5% latency regression at p50, hold and iterate on quant params. Agree? :thumbsup: 
Maria: Agreed. Customer needs an internal demo next Tue — timeline is tight.
Jordyn: I'll assemble a minimal demo prompt set and a short runbook for the customer-facing team. Ashwin, drop artifact links when ready.
Ashwin: Will upload GPTQ artifacts + quant logs to S3 and paste link here once done.
Maria: Thanks — tagging this P1 on the onboarding board and notifying solutions team.
notes: intake + triage for customer Frostwing 13B onboarding with 4-bit quant; includes actionable checklist and owners
